body:
Looks good to me. I don't know much about how `MASS` _should_ behave. But this matches the code that was in Godot 2.x (Godot 3.x didn't have attractors) which I assume matches how the `MASS` property is supposed to behave. 

Internally `mass` defaults to `1.0`, so this won't change existing projects. If anyone attempted to use `MASS` before the shader would fail to compile. So there is no real risk of breaking anything by fixing this.
